scope: Isolate hosted KEP client sessions, distinguish protocol identity from human and wallet control, export exact public preflight material, freeze operation identities, resume exact identity registration, persist safe attempt evidence, and preserve interruption state across the complete same-tab flow.

lanes.product_construction: Definitions PD19-PD27, product and business scaffolds, DomainSpec and compiled-system prototypes, Rust hosted contracts, browser session and card behavior, generated bundle, and current tests.
lanes.operational_support: One existing network-disabled Node container and one disposable loopback PostgreSQL test database were used only for local product validation.
lanes.deferred_operational_residue: Calibrated Playwright evidence, real wallet/browser trial, product approval, deployment candidate construction, VPS deployment, publication, and release.

digest_algorithm: sha256(sorted logical path + NUL + exact file bytes + NUL)
required_product_claim: A fresh hosted KEP task cannot inherit another session's role identity key or operation; one human or wallet may control distinct protocol identities without collapsing them; exact public inputs and operation IDs are available before signing; exact identity registration resumes without rebinding; and recorded attempt evidence remains durable and redacted.
excluded_claims: independent human or wallet custody proven when authority is shared
durable private-key backup beyond the same browser tab
real-wallet or live Devnet flow proven for these bytes
claim_ceiling: Exact locally tested product candidate only; not approved, accepted, admitted, deployed, live-tested, published, or released.
